description: package.json of an Express API scaffolded from a 2018-era tutorial and never upgraded: axios ^0.18.0 (SSRF via redirect, fixed in 0.21.1), jsonwebtoken ^7.4.3, and node-fetch ^2.1.2 (forwards Authorization/Cookie headers on cross-origin redirects, fixed in 2.6.7). VC131 must flag each declared range whose floor is a vulnerable version.
